<?php
class Token96A { function __destruct() { echo 'TOKEN|'; } }
class Base96A {
    public $label;
    function __construct($label) { $this->label = $label; }
    function capture() { return ('Base96A::stream')(...); }
    private function stream($token) {
        global $weakToken, $weakSource, $weakOld, $weakMaker;
        echo 'BODY|', self::tag() === 96, '|', static::class === 'Base96A', '|', $this === $weakMaker->get(), '|', $weakSource->get() === null, '|', $weakOld->get() === null, '|';
        try { yield $token; unset($token); Fiber::suspend('fake96A'); echo 'RESUMED|'; return 96; }
        finally { echo 'FIN|', $weakToken->get() instanceof Token96A, '|', $weakMaker->get() instanceof Base96A, '|'; }
    }
    private static function tag() { return 96; }
    function __destruct() { echo $this->label, '|'; }
}
class Child96A extends Base96A { public function stream($token) { echo 'BAD-CHILD|'; yield $token; } }
function Run96A() { global $g; echo 'SEND|'; $g->send(null); echo 'RETURNED|'; }
$old = new Child96A('OLD'); $weakOld = WeakReference::create($old);
$source = $old->capture(); $weakSource = WeakReference::create($source);
$maker = new Base96A('MAKER'); $weakMaker = WeakReference::create($maker);
$token = new Token96A(); $weakToken = WeakReference::create($token);
echo 'CALL|'; $g = $source->call($maker, $token);
unset($source, $old, $maker, $token);
echo 'FRESH|', $weakSource->get() === null, '|', $weakOld->get() === null, '|', $weakMaker->get() instanceof Base96A, '|', $weakToken->get() instanceof Token96A, '|';
echo 'PRIME|'; $g->current();
$fiber = new Fiber('Run96A'); echo 'START|'; $mark = $fiber->start();
echo 'PARK|', $mark === 'fake96A', '|', $g->current() === $weakToken->get(), '|', $weakMaker->get() instanceof Base96A, '|';
echo 'RESUME|'; $fiber->resume();
echo 'DONE|', $fiber->isTerminated(), '|', $g->getReturn() === 96, '|', $weakMaker->get() instanceof Base96A, '|', $weakToken->get() instanceof Token96A, '|';
unset($g, $fiber); echo 'DROP|', $weakMaker->get() === null, '|', $weakToken->get() === null, '|E';

<?php
class Token96B {
    function __destruct() { global $weakSource; echo 'TOKEN|', $weakSource->get() instanceof Closure, '|'; }
}
class Base96B {
    static function stream($token) { echo 'BAD-BODY|'; yield $token; }
    function __destruct() { global $weakSource; echo 'MAKER|', $weakSource->get() instanceof Closure, '|'; }
}
function NewMaker96B() { global $weakMaker; $maker = new Base96B(); $weakMaker = WeakReference::create($maker); return $maker; }
function NewToken96B() { global $weakToken; $token = new Token96B(); $weakToken = WeakReference::create($token); return $token; }
function Warn96B($severity, $message) {
    global $source, $weakSource, $weakMaker, $weakToken;
    echo 'WARN|', $severity === 2, '|', $message === 'Cannot bind an instance to a static closure', '|', $weakSource->get() instanceof Closure, '|', $weakMaker->get() instanceof Base96B, '|', $weakToken->get() instanceof Token96B, '|';
    $source = null;
    echo 'HELD|', $weakSource->get() instanceof Closure, '|'; return true;
}
$route = 'Base96B::stream'; $source = $route(...); $weakSource = WeakReference::create($source); unset($route);
set_error_handler('Warn96B'); echo 'CALL|'; $result = $source->call(NewMaker96B(), NewToken96B()); restore_error_handler();
echo 'AFTER|', $result === null, '|', $weakSource->get() === null, '|', $weakMaker->get() === null, '|', $weakToken->get() === null, '|E';
